steps.text: Something large is slumped against the roots at the roadside. An orc, armor scored and broken, not moving.

steps.speaker: fenwick
steps.text: Stars above. Still breathing. Only just.

steps.speaker: player
steps.text: Same wounds the wolf gave us. Look at the spacing. It had them before it had us.

steps.speaker: tharr
steps.text:
(kneeling, testing the orc's weight)
Then it is a debt.

steps.speaker: elara
steps.text: They are twice your size, mason.

steps.speaker: tharr
steps.text: Stone is heavier. Take the other arm.
